tasks.name: ברירת מחדל
tasks.note: Returns a, or b when a is 0.

tasks.name: קרובים מספיק
tasks.note: Flags 15 when the two inputs differ by at most 2, else 0.

tasks.name: תקרה שבע
tasks.note: Returns a, but never more than 7.

tasks.name: הנגדי
tasks.note: Returns the number that adds to a to give 0 modulo 16 (16 minus a, and 0 for 0).

tasks.name: הפיכת הביט העליון
tasks.note: Flips the top bit of a (adds 8 below 8, subtracts 8 from 8 up).

tasks.name: הביט הנמוך מהשני
tasks.note: Returns a with its lowest bit replaced by the lowest bit of b.

tasks.name: יתרה
tasks.note: Balance a plus deposit b minus withdrawal c, kept between 0 and 15.

tasks.name: הצד הגדול
tasks.note: Returns the larger of a and 15 minus a.

tasks.name: הזוגי הבא
tasks.note: Returns the next even number above a, wrapping modulo 16.

tasks.name: שניים גוברים על השלישי
tasks.note: Flags 15 when the first two inputs together are larger than the third, else 0.

tasks.name: שבועות
tasks.note: Returns how many weeks are needed to cover a days, that is a divided by 7 rounded up.

tasks.name: ריבוע חלקי שש-עשרה
tasks.note: Squares a and returns the result divided by 16, rounded down.

tasks.name: השלמה לכפולה
tasks.note: Returns how much must be added to a to reach a multiple of b, or 0 when b is 0.

tasks.name: האי-זוגי הגדול
tasks.note: Returns the larger of the odd inputs, or 0 when both are even.

tasks.name: מעל הממוצע מבין שלושה
tasks.note: Counts how many of the three inputs are strictly above their average.

tasks.name: מעבר לריבוע
tasks.src: a=>{ let k=0; while((k+1)*(k+1)<=a) k++; return a-k*k; }
tasks.note: Returns how far a lies above the largest perfect square not above it.

tasks.name: גורמים ראשוניים עם חזרות
tasks.src: a=>{ if(a<2) return 0; let c=0; for(let d=2;a>1;) if(a%d===0){ a/=d; c++; } else d++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts the prime factors of a with repetition (12 = 2*2*3 gives 3), 0 for 0 and 1.

tasks.name: הספרה הגדולה בבסיס ארבע
tasks.note: Returns the larger of the two base-4 digits of a.

tasks.name: מסלול המעלית
tasks.note: An elevator at floor a picks someone up at floor b and drops them at floor c; returns the floors travelled, capped at 15.

tasks.name: מספר משולשי
tasks.note: Flags 15 when a is a triangular number (0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15), else 0.

tasks.name: מהלכי צריח
tasks.note: Reads p and q as squares of a 4x4 board (row = top two bits, column = low two bits) and returns how many rook moves lead from p to q (0, 1 or 2).

tasks.name: פיצות
tasks.note: a people each eat b slices; returns how many 8-slice pizzas to order, capped at 15.

tasks.name: ממוצע במשקל כפול
tasks.note: Returns the weighted average of a (weight 2) and b (weight 1), rounded down.

tasks.name: ממתקים שנשארו
tasks.note: 15 sweets are shared equally among a children; returns how many are left over (0 when there are no children).

tasks.name: מינימום ריבועים
tasks.src: a=>{ const d=[0]; for(let n=1;n<=a;n++){ d[n]=99; for(let k=1;k*k<=n;k++) d[n]=Math.min(d[n],d[n-k*k]+1); } return d[a]; }
tasks.note: Returns the fewest perfect squares (1, 4, 9) that add up to a, 0 for zero.

tasks.name: מספרי קטלן
tasks.src: a=>{ const c=[1]; for(let n=1;n<=a;n++){ c[n]=0; for(let i=0;i<n;i++) c[n]+=c[i]*c[n-1-i]; } return c[a]%16; }
tasks.note: Returns the a-th Catalan number (1, 1, 2, 5, 14, 42, ...) modulo 16.

tasks.name: ספרות בבסיס
tasks.src: (a,b)=>{ if(b<2) return 0; let n=1; while(a>=b){ a=Math.floor(a/b); n++; } return n; }
tasks.note: Returns how many digits a has when written in base b, or 0 when b is below 2.

tasks.name: הסדר של שתיים
tasks.src: a=>{ if(a<3||a%2===0) return 0; let x=2%a, k=1; while(x!==1){ x=x*2%a; k++; } return k; }
tasks.note: For odd a above 1 returns the smallest k such that 2 to the power k leaves remainder 1 modulo a; 0 otherwise.

tasks.name: כדי מים
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ const seen=new Set([0]), q=[[0,0]]; while(q.length){ const [x,y]=q.shift(); if(x===c||y===c) return 15; const p=Math.min(x,b-y), r=Math.min(y,a-x); for(const [u,v] of [[a,y],[x,b],[0,y],[x,0],[x-p,y+p],[x+r,y-r]]){ const k=u*16+v; if(!seen.has(k)){ seen.add(k); q.push([u,v]); } } } return 0; }
tasks.note: With jugs holding a and b litres (fill, empty, pour one into the other), flags 15 when exactly c litres can be left in one jug, else 0.

tasks.name: משחק הלקיחה
tasks.src: a=>{ const w=[]; for(let n=0;n<=a;n++) w[n]=[1,3,4].some(k=>k<=n&&!w[n-k]); return w[a]?15:0; }
tasks.note: Players alternately take 1, 3 or 4 tokens from a pile of a and whoever cannot move loses; flags 15 when the first player can force a win.

tasks.name: אחדות עד a
tasks.src: a=>{ let s=0; for(let x=1;x<=a;x++) for(let y=x;y;y>>=1) s+=y&1; return Math.min(15,s); }
tasks.note: Counts all set bits in the numbers from 1 to a, capped at 15.

tasks.name: הבא בלי ביטים צמודים
tasks.src: a=>{ for(let x=a+1;x<16;x++) if(!(x&(x>>1))) return x; return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the next number above a whose binary form has no two neighbouring 1 bits, or 0 if there is none.

tasks.name: גולדבך
tasks.src: a=>{ const pr=n=>{ if(n<2) return false; for(let d=2;d*d<=n;d++) if(n%d===0) return false; return true; }; for(let p=2;p<=a;p++) if(pr(p)&&pr(a-p)) return p; return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the smallest prime p such that a minus p is also prime, or 0 when there is none.

tasks.name: הצפרדע בבאר
tasks.src: (a,b,c)=>{ if(!c) return 0; let h=0; for(let d=1;d<=15;d++){ h+=a; if(h>=c) return d; h=Math.max(0,h-b); } return 15; }
tasks.note: A frog climbs a metres each day and slips back b each night in a well c metres deep; returns the day it gets out (0 for depth 0), capped at 15.
